reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  -- one row per user who signed up in September 2025, UTC
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id, signup_ts
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
last_touch AS (
  -- one row per signup with a session at or before it: when the last such session started
  SELECT c.user_id, MAX(s.session_start) AS last_start
  FROM cohort AS c
  JOIN sessions AS s ON s.visitor_id = c.visitor_id AND s.session_start <= c.signup_ts
  GROUP BY c.user_id
),
signup_channel AS (
  -- one row per signup, with the channel of its last session, or unattributed
  SELECT c.user_id, c.signup_ts,
         CASE WHEN s.session_id IS NULL THEN 'unattributed'
              WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel
  FROM cohort AS c
  LEFT JOIN last_touch AS lt ON lt.user_id = c.user_id
  LEFT JOIN sessions AS s ON s.visitor_id = c.visitor_id AND s.session_start = lt.last_start
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS cp ON cp.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id
),
activation AS (
  -- one row per signup, with 1 when it sent its first campaign within 7 days of signing up
  SELECT sc.user_id, sc.signup_ts, sc.channel,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM activation_events AS a
           WHERE a.user_id = sc.user_id
             AND a.event_name = 'first_campaign_sent'
             AND a.event_ts <= sc.signup_ts + INTERVAL '7 days'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS activated
  FROM signup_channel AS sc
),
steps AS (
  -- one row per signup, with 1 for paid only when it activated and a subscription started by the 30th day
  SELECT ac.channel, ac.activated,
         CASE WHEN ac.activated = 1 AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM subscriptions AS sb
           WHERE sb.user_id = ac.user_id
             AND sb.start_date <= CAST(ac.signup_ts AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 days'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid
  FROM activation AS ac
)
SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS signups,
       SUM(activated) AS activated,
       SUM(paid) AS paid,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(activated) / COUNT(*), 1) AS activation_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(paid) / NULLIF(SUM(activated), 0), 1) AS paid_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(paid) / COUNT(*), 1) AS overall_rate_pct
FROM steps
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY overall_rate_pct DESC, channel

         CASE WHEN fa.activated_at <= sc.signup_ts + INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS activated,
         CASE WHEN fa.activated_at <= sc.signup_ts + INTERVAL '7 days'
               AND fs.first_start <= CAST(sc.signup_ts AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS paid
  FROM signup_channel AS sc
  LEFT JOIN first_activation AS fa ON fa.user_id = sc.user_id
  LEFT JOIN first_subscription AS fs ON fs.user_id = sc.user_id

SELECT t.channel,
       COUNT(*) AS signups,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1) AS activated,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1 AND t.subscribed = 1) AS paid,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS activation_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1 AND t.subscribed = 1)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1), 0), 1) AS paid_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.activated = 1 AND t.subscribed = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS overall_rate_pct
FROM (
  -- one row per September 2025 signup, with its channel and the steps it reached
  SELECT g.user_id,
         CASE WHEN s.session_id IS NULL THEN 'unattributed'
              WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM activation_events AS a
           WHERE a.user_id = g.user_id
             AND a.event_name = 'first_campaign_sent'
             AND a.event_ts <= g.signup_ts + INTERVAL '7 days'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS activated,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM subscriptions AS sb
           WHERE sb.user_id = g.user_id
             AND sb.start_date <= CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 days'
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS subscribed
  FROM (
    -- one row per September 2025 signup, with when its last session at or before signing up started
    SELECT g0.user_id, g0.visitor_id, g0.signup_ts, MAX(s0.session_start) AS last_start
    FROM signups AS g0
    LEFT JOIN sessions AS s0 ON s0.visitor_id = g0.visitor_id AND s0.session_start <= g0.signup_ts
    WHERE g0.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00'
      AND g0.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
    GROUP BY g0.user_id, g0.visitor_id, g0.signup_ts
  ) AS g
  LEFT JOIN sessions AS s ON s.visitor_id = g.visitor_id AND s.session_start = g.last_start
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS cp ON cp.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id
) AS t
GROUP BY t.channel
ORDER BY overall_rate_pct DESC, t.channel

WITH su AS (
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id, CAST(signup_ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS ts
  FROM signups
  WHERE CAST(signup_ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND CAST(signup_ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
sess AS (
  SELECT s.visitor_id, CAST(s.session_start AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS st, s.session_id,
         CASE WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN c.channel_name
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS ch
  FROM sessions s
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT cp.utm_campaign, ch.channel_name
             FROM campaigns cp JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = cp.channel_id) c
         ON c.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
),
lastsess AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, arg_max(x.ch, struct_pack(t := x.st, i := x.session_id)) AS ch
  FROM su u
  JOIN sess x ON x.visitor_id = u.visitor_id AND x.st <= u.ts
  GROUP BY u.user_id
),
f AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.ch, 'unattributed') AS channel,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activation_events e
                 WHERE e.user_id = u.user_id AND e.event_name = 'first_campaign_sent'
                   AND CAST(e.event_ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) <= u.ts + INTERVAL 168 HOUR) AS act,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions b
                 WHERE b.user_id = u.user_id
                   AND CAST(b.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(u.ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) + 30) AS sub
  FROM su u LEFT JOIN lastsess l ON l.user_id = u.user_id
),
g AS (
  SELECT channel,
         COUNT(*) AS signups,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE act) AS activated,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE act AND sub) AS paid
  FROM f GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, signups, activated, paid,
       ROUND(100.0 * activated / signups, 1) AS activation_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * paid / NULLIF(activated, 0), 1) AS paid_rate_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * paid / signups, 1) AS overall_rate_pct
FROM g
ORDER BY overall_rate_pct DESC, channel
